title: <short human title>

commands.install: <install deps for every package, or "" if none — e.g. "cargo fetch && flutter pub get">
commands.test: <run every package's unit suite — e.g. "cargo test && flutter test">
commands.grade: <wrapper that runs every package's hidden grader and reports combined worst-case — e.g. "bash grade.sh", "make grade">

primaryBug: <one line: the silent, subset-only bug — for Cedar, its true cause lives across a boundary (reference/) and/or in a no-doc-trace stale path>
featureTrap: <one line: the invariant the naive implementation trips>
assistantTrap: <one line: how an autopilot run provably loops — symptom-patch stays red; the obvious fix passes the visible suite but fails a case needing real understanding (FM-13, required)>
docDriftTrap: <one line: the authoritative-looking doc/comment that contradicts the current code, and the stale code path with no doc trace (FM-15)>
crossBoundaryTrap: <one line: the truth that lives only in reference/ and the wrong assumption a single-scope run makes (FM-16)>
notes: <anything a future maintainer needs — e.g. the dual grade gate or its Rust-only fallback>
